mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have fair conditions and a comfortable 70 degrees near City Hall. If you look to the sky tonight at 6:32 PM, you can catch the space station as it rises over Mount Horeb and travels toward the Madison area, sitting about halfway up the sky.

Important updates for the city include upcoming election notices for the November general election, along with a plan commission meeting on December 7th regarding the new Sub Zero site plan in Liberty Business Park.

It is a busy time for our community! Events today include the Dane County Farmers Market and live music at both Baileys Run and Paddy Macs. Looking ahead, tomorrow features music at Lake Lou-ee and the John Denver tribute show at the Verona Area High School Fine Arts Center.
In our weekly look at local public safety, we report that on October 25, officers arrested a man for an O W I after he was discovered stopped at the intersection of Plympton Street and Rita Avenue.
Culver's of Verona is currently open until 10:30 PM, so stop in to enjoy today's flavor of the day, which is Caramel Cashew.
